method: Manual interaction in the in-app browser; downloaded artifacts and persisted counts checked separately through local files and read-only HTTP
scope: Workflow exercised on an isolated SQLite database with all external HTTP blocked, then the final source was started on the main local workspace. The real-case import restores frozen evidence and does not rerun upstream tests. No new GPT request was made.

checks.name: Select a simulation terminal
checks.observed: Selecting one demo occurrence changes the hypothetical remaining count from two to one.

checks.name: Shared workbench and presenter state
checks.observed: The selected occurrence is retained when entering the presenter and reset changes are visible after exiting.

checks.name: All and reset actions
checks.observed: Selecting all yields two assumed handled and zero remaining; reset restores zero handled and two remaining.

checks.name: Snapshot isolation
checks.observed: Switching to demo-partial discards the previous selection and starts with one actual target occurrence.

checks.name: Five-stage narrative
checks.observed: Source, original evidence and paths, simulation, real-case verification and report stages render separately.

checks.name: Keyboard navigation and focus
checks.observed: ArrowRight changes stage, Escape closes the dialog and focus returns to the full-screen presentation button.

checks.name: Unavailable evidence and answer
checks.observed: Before the real-case bundle existed the presenter showed unavailable material; a snapshot without an answer explicitly showed no answer, with no generated substitute.

checks.name: Desktop stage layout
checks.observed: At 1280 by 720 the short demo simulation displays the assumption notice, metrics, controls and two paths within the presentation stage.

checks.name: Narrow-screen layout
checks.observed: At 390 by 844 the document and dialog width remained 390 pixels; content was scrollable with no horizontal document overflow. Viewport override was reset.

checks.name: System-fullscreen fallback
checks.observed: The in-app browser did not enable system fullscreen. The full-page dialog remained usable and explicitly stated that browser system fullscreen was not enabled.

checks.name: Recorded real-case provenance
checks.observed: Fixed source commit, MIT license, target advisory, 2-to-1-to-0 recorded counts, three actual test commands and the two after-stage assertion API migrations are shown.

checks.name: Restore real-case snapshots
checks.observed: The load action created three selectable case snapshots and selected the original before snapshot; the presenter continued to label the test results as saved experimental records.

checks.name: Multiple paths share one exact occurrence
checks.observed: On the real case, choosing direct minimist changed three representative paths together while the bundled minimist remained. Counts were two original, one handled and one remaining.

checks.name: Zero preview preserves unknown coverage
checks.observed: Selecting both real-case occurrences produced zero hypothetical remaining while keeping the incomplete-graph warning; read-only API verification confirmed actual counts remained 2, 1 and 0.

checks.name: Actual partial snapshot
checks.observed: The actual partial lockfile showed one bundled minimist occurrence through tap, with no inherited hypothetical selection.

checks.name: Actual before/after comparison
checks.observed: The comparison displayed remaining and new advisories; disappeared matches were not labelled fully eliminated because graph coverage is incomplete.

checks.name: Snapshot HTML report download
checks.observed: The presenter report link downloaded the actual after-snapshot HTML report; the report includes fixed-source provenance, three-stage test records and coverage limitations.

checks.name: Case manifest download
checks.observed: The expanded evidence link downloaded case.json; the downloaded bytes match SHA-256 a737ddf3a515dee53f77a1d5394ca1a7a47ebf07a7bea124470e6968a62e3975.

checks.name: Main workspace upgrade
checks.observed: The main local application displayed v0.7, retained its existing GPT connection status, loaded the frozen case and presented both simulation and actual-case stages without a model call.

checks.name: Browser console
checks.observed: The isolated and main application tabs had no captured console errors after the checks.

limitations: This is a manual acceptance record, not an automated end-to-end suite or a semantic answer-accuracy score.
System browser fullscreen was unavailable in the embedded browser; the full-page presentation fallback was verified.
The real-case graphs remain incomplete. Zero observed matches for the target advisory does not establish global safety or deployment readiness.
The upstream experiment was executed separately and its logs are preserved. Browser load and CI offline verification do not rerun those tests.
There was no new v0.7 paid-model acceptance run; the previous v0.6 three-answer acceptance is recorded separately.
